scoring_note: Lineup read as team QB, 2 RB, 3 WR/TE, team K, DEF. Points allowed on a projection: the league's bands (0, 1–3) are spread over the defense projection's (0, 1–6, 7–13 …) by the average over each. Kicks of 50+ yards on a projection: priced at the 50–59 band (10); the projection does not split off 60+. Return touchdowns are not projected (they count on actual lines). 2-point conversions are not projected.
